_doc: Electronic-music style table: the internal taxonomy that drives sample generation. Not shown on the site. Drum lanes follow assets/drumkits/infinite-basic (kick,snare,closed hat,open hat,clap,low tom,high tom,bell); 16 steps, x=hit o=soft .=rest. scale = MusicTime ScaleType index (0 maj,1 min,2 harm min,3 mel min,4 dorian,5 phrygian,6 lydian,7 mixolydian,8 locrian,9 maj pent,10 min pent,11 blues,12 whole tone,13 chromatic). rate = RateDivision index (6 1/4, 9 1/8, 12 1/16). bass = scale degrees per 16th (0=root, .=rest). glitch 0..1 = how much stutter/bitcrush/stop-start the style tolerates. mod 0..1 = how much the modulators move. Research notes in docs/plans/patch-corpus/taxonomy/music.md.
